----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through P.p.
2. Ramdas Agrawal Son Of Late Shri Hanuman Prasad  Agrawal, Proprietor M/s Goyal Builders, Office Cum  Residence B-62, Natraj Nagar, Imliwala Phatak, Jaipur  (Rajasthan).
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajneesh Gupta with Mr. Rahul Sharma For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.S. Mehla,
PP Mr. Amitabh Vijayvargiya HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN Order 14/08/2024 1.

This petition under Section 482 Cr. P.C. is filed, with a prayer to quash the FIR No. 259/2022 registered at police station, Bajaj Nagar, Jaipur City (East) for offences under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC, on the basis of compromise effectuated between the parties herein, in respect of their inter-se dispute.
2. Learned counsel for both the parties have submitted that the dispute at hand is inter-se private in nature, which has been resolved by the parties amicably.

At the outset, this Court deems it appropriate to place reliance upon the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab [(2012) 10 SCC 303] and Ramgopal Vs. The Kripal Singh Son Of Shri Dafedar Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:34666) on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24359970/

sentences.text: State of Madhya Pradesh reported in [2022 (14) SCC 531], relevant portion of which is reproduced below:

"12. The High Court, therefore, having regard to the nature of the offence and the fact that parties have amicably settled their dispute and the victim has willingly consented to the nullification of criminal proceedings, can quash such proceedings in exercise of its inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C., even if the offences are non- compoundable."

5. In view of the position of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in aforementioned case, and considering the personal nature of dispute, which has been amicably settled between parties, this Court deems it just and proper to allow the present misc. petition.

6. Considering the aforementioned, the present criminal miscellaneous petition is allowed and the FIR No. 259/2022 registered at police station, Bajaj Nagar, Jaipur City (East) with all consequential proceedings, are hereby quashed and set aside.
